landing.step1_desc: Describe what you need, pick your barangay, and set your budget. Takes less than 2 minutes — no calls, no guesswork.

landing.join_badge: In Partnership with PESO Tuy, Batangas
landing.join_desc: KaAyos helps Filipino workers earn more, reach more clients, and build a professional reputation — without relying on referrals alone.
landing.faq_q1: Is it safe to let a worker into my home?
landing.faq_a1: Yes — every KaAyos worker completes a government-ID and barangay clearance check before accepting jobs, and PESO accreditation adds an official layer of screening. You can also read their full rating history and past client reviews before booking, and cancel free of charge any time before the job starts.
landing.faq_q2: What does PESO accreditation mean, and why does it matter?
landing.faq_a2: The Public Employment Service Office (PESO) is the government's official employment agency. PESO-accredited workers are vetted for real skills, verified identity, and accountable conduct — your assurance that KaAyos workers are formally recognized professionals, not just names online.
landing.faq_q3: How much does it cost? Are there hidden fees?
landing.faq_a3: Posting a job is completely free, and you pay only after the job is done. The final price is shown to you upfront — including a small, transparent 10% platform fee that keeps KaAyos running and protects our workers. No surprise charges, ever.
landing.faq_q4: Which areas and barangays do you cover?
landing.faq_a4: KaAyos serves all 22 barangays of Tuy, Batangas — from Acle to Tuyon-Tuyon. We only match you with workers who can reach your area quickly, so response times stay fast. Nearby towns are coming soon.
landing.faq_q5: Can I register as both a homeowner and a worker?
landing.faq_a5: Yes. One account supports both roles. Switch between them from your dashboard.
